subject.title: [Feature]: Audio file support in read tool (multimodal parity with images)

question: Should OpenClaw add native audio attachment support to the read tool, or keep audio routed through media-understanding transcription until a broader provider/media contract is approved?
rationale: Current source has image-specific read-tool and prompt-image injection plus separate audio transcription policy; native audio changes provider payload routing and raw-media egress behavior rather than only fixing a parser bug.

options.title: Approve shared native audio
options.body: Define provider capability metadata, read-tool output shape, transcript/session storage, and security policy, then implement audio only through that contract.

options.title: Keep transcription-first audio
options.body: Leave read as text/image-only and direct voice/audio workflows through media-understanding transcription until native media input is a larger roadmap item.

options.title: Prototype in plugin/API design
options.body: Use a provider or plugin experiment to prove native audio routing before promoting new core read-tool behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve shared native audio
recommendation.body: Define provider capability metadata, read-tool output shape, transcript/session storage, and security policy, then implement audio only through that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame places the read-tool and prompt-image plumbing on steipete's commit, making him the best available owner for the boundary decision.
